statement.zh: 乌姆卡阿布 U-j 骨签/墨书构成“埃及最早文字”或可与两河原始文字并列为世界最早书写——此为争议性解读，本条不升为定论。
statement.en: That Umm el-Qaab U-j bone labels/ink inscriptions constitute “Egypt’s earliest writing” or co-equal world’s earliest writing with Mesopotamian proto-writing is a contested reading; not elevated to fact here.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: Dreyer 1998 publishes U-j and early writing evidence as finds; comparative “earliest writing” rankings and full linguistic decipherment claims remain debated. Keep in hypothesis column.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only; density pass 3.
